description: Create a family event on the household calendar (trip, party, appointment, birthday...). Multi-day events show on every day they span. A party gets a shareable RSVP link (rsvp_url) to paste into any messenger.

assignees.description: Who it's for: member names (array or comma-separated). Omit, [] or 'Everyone' = Everyone (default).

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default start_date. Multi-day trips: the last day

name: add_event
